## Features
- **Power Five panel** at the top of the Plan tab: the five heroes carrying the run, with level,
  share of DPS and next-level cost. Collapsible — click the header to fold it away and see the plan,
  and the open/closed state is remembered.
- The same heroes are marked **P1-P5** in the Heroes tab with tinted rows.
- **Launch on game start, not at login**: a watcher service starts the companion when Clicker Heroes
  launches; the Settings checkbox turns it off.

## Bug Fixes
- **Ascension and transcension logs now import.** The parsers demanded one exact CSV shape and
  silently dropped anything else, so pasted exports produced "no rows". They now accept extra
  columns, tab/semicolon separators, header blocks, a BOM and K/M/B suffixes, and the clipboard
  import recognises a log by its content rather than its first line.
